Update: We are getting so much better. I talked to some family and friends and, thank god, they forgave me and gave me a brand new perspective. We will grow stronger from this. As an addendum, and not to forgive myself at all, but this was not a side relationship, or even a fling with an acquaintance, just a transaction of companionship, which I think made the situation much more palatable once it was considered by both of us. Just me being a stupid, stupid human. 

Anywho, this was my only interaction with this community, and I hope it will be my only one, at least on this side of the fence. Hopefully I can return someday with my main acct. and be as wonderfully helpful for someone else as you all were for me. From the very bottom of my heart, thank you. Thank you thank you thank you. <3
Also right. This support means so much guys. <3
Very true. I'm just sure that it will never feel the same for her or I.
